description: The one search request read by the CLI flags and the MCP tool.

cursor.description: The continuation from an earlier page of the same search.

exclude_terminal.description:
Omit terminal records. A text search sets true when omitted; a file search
returns every bound Rule and refuses true.

file.description: A repository-relative source file. Returns the Rules bound in that file.

line.description: A line in the file. Rules bound at that line come first.

symbol.description: A symbol in the file. Rules bound to that symbol come first.

text.description: Text to find in record ids and text.
